name: UOB Professionals Platinum Card

percent:baseline.note: S$5 local spend = UNI$1. UNI$2000 redeems $20 vouchers. Equivalent to 0.2% cashback.

percent:overseas.note: (Indirect Cashback) S$5 local spend = UNI$1. UNI$2000 redeems $20 voucher. Equivalent to 0.2% cashback.

percent:local.note: S$5 local spend = UNI$1. UNI$2000 redeems $20 vouchers. Equivalent to 0.2% cashback.

highlights: pros: Earn 1 SMART$ for every S$1 spent to offset your purchases.
pros: Get up to 10% SMART$ rebate at participating stores islandwide.
pros: Exclusive dining offers at the likes of Din Tai Fung, The Fullerton Hotel Singapore, Goodwood Park Hotel, Timbre and more.
pros: Enjoy up to 20.8% and 24% fuel savings at Shell and SPC respectively.
cons: Applicant must be an existing member of Alumni Association, ISCA, Law Society of Singapore, SMA or ACCA.
cons: UNI$ will not be awarded on transactions at SMART$ merchants where SMART$ are issued.

extra.description: The UOB Professionals Platinum Card lets you earn Rewards Points on your daily spending to offset your future purchases. It also provides cardholders with exclusive dining offers at select merchants.
